title: authorization.role.unassigned (v1)
description: A role assignment was removed. Emitted when a role assignment is removed through the administration API, when ownership transfer releases the previous owner's role, or when the worker removes an expired time-bound assignment. Not emitted for assignments deleted as a side effect of membership removal, service principal deletion or user deletion. org_id is set for organization-scoped assignments. The assignment identifier is not included.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

org_id.description: Set only when the event is bound to an organization (see description).
